sections.heading: Trust as a Feature
sections.body: Trust is a first-class feature. We design to respect time, attention, and privacy. Dark patterns are anti-vibes; we avoid them categorically. Our metrics include user well-being and long-term retention.

sections.heading: Consent and Clarity
sections.body: We ask permission clearly, explain why, and offer a meaningful choice. Defaults are conservative. We avoid manipulative copy and give users simple ways to change their mind.

sections.heading: Data Dignity
sections.body: We collect minimal data and explain benefits. We provide export and delete options. We write policies in human-readable language. Data dignity strengthens brand and reduces support burden.

sections.heading: Inclusive Research
sections.body: We test with diverse participants and assistive technologies. We compensate fairly and treat all feedback with respect. Empathy is not a workshop; it is a daily practice.

sections.heading: Exercises
sections.body: Rewrite a permissions dialog in plain language. Add a cancel path to a high-pressure flow. Review analytics collection and remove events that do not serve the user.
